headlines.text: Back on this day in 2021, Thunder Rosa vs. Britt Baker settled things in a Lights Out match, headlining the show on Dynamite, rated 8.66 ? a war that left everything in the ring in a standout Women's division showcase ? part of that year's St Patrick Day's Slam '21. A historic night ? the first-ever women's match to main event AEW Dynamite, and it delivered fully on the occasion: a bloody, brutal Lights Out brawl with thumbtacks, tables, and a ladder, capping the best women's feud AEW had produced to that point.
Back on this day in 2023, Harv Sihra arrived in AEW, appearing on Rampage, rated 4.26.
2021 brought us this moment: Luke Gallows was no more, reborn as Doc Gallows after 3 matches, on Dynamite.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2023, Powerhouse Hobbs vs. Rey Fenix fought tooth and nail for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.27 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.
Rewind to 2021, when it was the first-ever encounter between Rey Fenix and Angelico on Dynamite, rated 5.72.
Turning the clock back to 2021: it was the first-ever encounter between Cody Rhodes and Penta El Zero M, kicking off the show on Dynamite, rated 6.11.
